newsitem.title: USA: Venture Stores October same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Venture Stores October same-store sales off.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc said comparable-store sales for the four weeks ended October 26 declined 28.2 percent. Total sales were $98.1 million, down 30.9 percent from sales of $141.9 million a year earlier.
For the third quarter, comparable sales fell 22.4 percent. Total sales for the quarter were $330.2 million, down 25.7 percent from $444.6 million in the 1995 third-quarter.
The retailer operates 113 stores in nine states.

Earlier Wednesday, it reported a third-quarter loss of $0.54 per share compared to a year-ago loss of $0.76 per share which included nonrecurring after-tax charges of $0.19 per share for a repositioning program.
Venture said it completed the second of a five-stage repositioning effort that includes enlarging various departments and introducing new product lines.
